text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates donates food, medicine to Iraq.
- Representatives of 50 French companies to visit Iraq on January 20.
- President Saddam receives congratulations on fasting month of Ramadan from son of late Egyptian president Nasser.
- Several Kurds have returned to national fold since President Saddam issued amnesty to army deserters in Kurdish area on December 25.
(The above stories were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
